notes: v1.16: Return first, then Sell — on Return Box, if the box comes back lighter than expected, the Sale panel opens automatically with the missing weight already in Sold (e.g. opening 400 g, return 300 g -> Sold 100.00 g; you only fill Mode/Amount/Bill No.); the sale is saved before the box closes, so it then closes with difference 0. Cancelling the Sale panel falls back to the old return-with-reason flow, and a heavier-than-expected return never opens the Sale panel.
